what: A pixel icon drawn with cells (path·rect) lights up one cell every .03s in random order once its top edge reaches 85% of the screen (each cell lags .05s). After a 2s rest it shakes once every 3~6s. In 10% of shakes all remaining cells switch off in .01s steps, then switch back on in the same order after .4s. In the rest, 8~50 of the remaining cells switch off for .01s, repeated 1~2 times (the rest while off is .2~1s in 80% of cases, otherwise .2s). Cells within 10px (+ half a cell width) of a segment the mouse has passed over stay erased for 1~4s

options.enter: ”scroll” (default) turns on when entering the screen · ”load” turns on right after attaching · ”none” only shakes without turning on
options.start: Start point for turning on (ScrollTrigger start), default top 85%
options.on: Time until slots turn on (sec), default .05
options.rest: Seconds from fully on until the first shake, default 2 — original icon row 1, standalone icons random 0~2
options.full: Probability of cutting out completely, default .1
options.few-min: Minimum cells blinking at once, default 8
options.few-max: Max cells blinking at once, default 50
options.reach: Distance (px) at which the cursor path erases cells, added to half the cell width, default 10
options.hide-min: Min (seconds) until an erased cell returns, default 1
options.hide-max: Max (seconds) until an erased cell returns, default 4

use: — In the svg, each path·rect is one cell (25 to 60 cells suit a 12×12 cell icon)
note: The original is random, so the picture is not identical, but the cycle, range and group size are the same. Cursor hiding applies only to a mouse (pointerType mouse) — touch is not blocked

from.where: shared.js pixelIcon — two icon titles on index (Ready to Glow·Just Landed, 51px 12×12 cells), the shop header icon title (rest 2), eight icon rows in about details (75px, each icon .15s later, rest 1)
